questions.stem: The surface area of a prism is found by adding:

options.text: The area of one face multiplied by the number of faces
The cross-sectional area multiplied by the length
The area of the two end faces and the total area of all rectangular side faces
The perimeter multiplied by the height

questions.explanation: The surface area of a prism equals the area of the two identical end faces (cross-sections) plus the areas of all the rectangular side faces.
